## Appearance

_Not yet known._

## Personality

John Tremayne is prone to experiencing periodic trances or spells. During these states, he has the ability to perceive things that are otherwise hidden from normal awareness.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P10](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0010)_

## History

John Tremayne emigrated from the Old Country to work as an instructor at the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) schoolhouse, during which time he experienced peculiar trances he claimed were inherited from an ancestor burned as a witch. While lodging with Captain Saul Garrick's father, he formed a close friendship with the young [Garrick](../character/uncle-saul.md) despite their ten-year age difference. Upon the arrival of [Damaris Leigh](../character/damaris-leigh.md), John married her in an evening ceremony at the [Garrick](../character/uncle-saul.md) home attended by locals and visitors, later planting rose bushes outside their home for his new bride.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P5](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P10](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P45](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0045), [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P12](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0012)_
